decisions.reason: The dedicated page and sensing fit indicate low keeping cost and unresolved upside, so the option remains worth keeping open.
As a core voltage measurement replacement, demand is established and uncertainty low, so the option stays open at little cost.
Software proxy has minimal keeping cost and MQTT connectivity remains valuable, so keep the option open.
